name: gift-platform
description: GIFT — AI-Powered Finance Education & Investment Intelligence Platform

scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "SERVER,CLIENT,ML" --prefix-colors "green,cyan,yellow" "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run ml"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build:core: cd core-engine && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build --config Release
